title: The Unlikely Best Friends
subject: English
summary: “The Unlikely Best Friends” is a story about two animals, a baby elephant named Gajaraj and a dog named Buntee. They lived in a stable and became good friends. They loved spending time together and playing with each other. One day, Buntee was taken away from the stable. Gajaraj became very sad and stopped eating. The caretaker noticed his sadness and brought Buntee back. When the two friends met again, they were very happy. Their friendship showed that true friendship does not depend on size, shape or appearance. The story teaches us that true friendship is based on love, care and understanding.
